title: CODEBENCHGEN: CREATING SCALABLE EXECUTION-BASED CODE GENERATION BENCHMARKS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether models perform better on tests generated by themselves by comparing the Pass@1 scores of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on test cases generated by GPT-3.5 versus those generated by GPT-4.

Measuring the diversity of libraries, repository topics, and number of contributors in existing code generation datasets to demonstrate that they are biased towards mature projects with human-written tests, compared to the natural code distribution in the Stack dataset.
